objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has leveraged scheduled tasks to execute itself as system.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)(Citation: CarveyODonnellWelchHuntress_TheGentlemen_May2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also established persistence through the creation of scheduled tasks to include `schtasks /Create /SC ONSTART /TN UpdateSystem /TR “<malware_path>” /RU SYSTEM` and `schtasks /Create /SC ONSTART /TN UpdateUser /TR “<malware_path>”`. [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has deleted pre-existing scheduled tasks using `schtasks /Delete /TN UpdateSystem /F` and `schtasks /Delete /TN UpdateUser /F`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
